method: Remove stacked base thumb edits, restore pre-opposition thumb geometry/weights; author volume-preserving weapon targets in Blender and inverse-bake to existing linear skinning. Plate opposition rotates around the palm long axis. No runtime DQ solver. v2/v3 web displacement is relaxed on welded vertices and constrained offline to retain at least 12% of each affected triangle area across the sampled native clips.
limitations: The dense animation files are composed review bakes, not replacements for native additive game clips.
The transition fix was verified using captured native states and the actual Animancer runtime in Unity; no new in-game recording after installation yet.
Triangle-area checks do not prove absence of all hand/weapon intersections.
CPU timing is an editor microbenchmark, not an in-game FPS or GPU measurement.
